chip.description: Sprite generator paired with the 053247 or the 055673: holds global X/Y offsets, flip and object-DMA controls and the graphics-ROM read address.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k053246_k053247_k055673.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("053247/053246 ... Sprite generators"; "053246 memory map (but the 053247 sees and processes them too)"). MAME models the pair with the k053247 or k055673 device, so this chip row has no mame_device row of its own. konamiic.txt records that the version 2 System GX mainboard substitutes the equivalent 058142 in a smaller package.
